scope: Add material regions to existing photo-derived front exterior only; unchanged geometry and original representative image. Unknown side/rear/roof neutral. Not a surveyed building or complete contemporary as-built reconstruction.

source.attribution_evidence: Public official map script AdmiB binds Chinese 行政大樓 and this image path. Photo shows identifying offset square lattice, four-storey long block and projecting entrance canopy.
source.caption_correction: English title in map script incorrectly says Chung Cheng Auditorium; do not propagate. Chinese selector and actual photo distinguish this building from adjacent auditorium.
source.photo_date: Not stated; do not treat retrieval date or disaster table date as capture date.
source.access: Normal public HTML and image download; no login or bypass.

existing_pdf_status.result: Web index identifies 86 pages, but screenshot cache miss. Two ordinary downloads returned HTTP503. Page13 photo not actually inspected in this review; not relied on for color GO.

regions.region: Front sunshade lattice and surrounding visible pale wall
regions.evidence: Light grey-beige near-white square lattice visible; apparent darkness varies strongly with shadows.
Muted dark green-grey surfaces behind lattice; use opaque visual proxy, not claim every cavity is glass. Recess returns retain pale wall tone.
Blue-grey dark glazing visible among lattice; no reflected sky or trees painted.

regions.region: Existing window frame faces if geometrically identifiable
regions.evidence: Muted silver-grey frames; do not create new frame geometry.
Weathered grey-brown band directly visible above pale lattice. Do not spread onto unseen roof top or rear.
Pale grey-beige canopy fascia and piers; shadows not literal black material.
Dark display board visible on canopy; no invented digital text, school label or gold letters.

regions.region: Stairs, roof top, rear/side estimates and display base
regions.evidence: Neutral proxy for uncertain or artificial surfaces; front stairs broadly concrete grey. Side bands are not proven glazing.

limits: Source photo is 700x525 and partly tree-obscured. Exact pigment/material specification is unverified; approximate sRGB only.
One official front-oblique photograph is sufficient only for broad front color classes, not hidden facades or roof finish.
Distant main-library volume behind administrative building is excluded; do not paint/add it as roof equipment.
Baseline lattice counts/depth and rear mass remain approximate. Color does not remove original QA warnings or imply actual trial printing.
Original photographs and private research images must not be distributed in public model package.
No new vegetation, vehicles, people, air conditioners, signage text or geometry.
